title: DecartStreamAdapter
responsibility: Connect canvas video through an injected safe transport with bounded lifetime and deterministic cleanup.

inputs.name: DecartStreamAdapter.constructor.canvas
inputs.description: The canvas that connect captures with canvas.captureStream(25); the constructor only stores it in a private readonly field, and the adapter requests no camera or microphone.

inputs.name: DecartStreamAdapter.connect.session
inputs.description: A RenderSession passed unchanged to the connector in its session option; the adapter reads only seconds, which arms a timer that stops the preview after seconds * 1000 milliseconds. Sessions from DecartAdapter.start carry an integer seconds value from 10 to 60.

inputs.name: DecartStreamAdapter.connect.prompt
inputs.description: Prompt text as a string, or an object with prompt text, an optional AbortSignal whose abort stops the preview, and an optional VideoConnector. Connecting needs a connector, so a string prompt or an object without connector makes connect reject.

examples.prompt: a quiet harbor at dawn in soft watercolor

examples: slow pan across a foggy pine forest

inputs.name: DecartStreamAdapter.connect.onStream
inputs.description: Called with the remote MediaStream that the connector reports through onRemoteStream while the preview is running. A remote stream that arrives after the preview has stopped has its tracks stopped and is not passed to this callback.

outputs.name: decartTransportReady
outputs.description: Always false in this implementation: the function returns the literal false because the public vendor SDK puts its client credential in a URL and no safe transport is registered. connect does not read this value, and a connection needs a connector in the prompt.

outputs.name: DecartStreamAdapter.connect
outputs.type: Promise<{ stop(): void; ended(): boolean; setPrompt(text: string): void }>
outputs.description: Resolves to controls: stop() stops the captured and remote tracks and disconnects the connection (repeat calls do nothing), ended() reports whether the preview has stopped, and setPrompt(text) forwards text to the connection and stops the preview if that call rejects. The preview also stops once session.seconds * 1000 milliseconds have passed, when the document becomes hidden, when the prompt's signal aborts, or when the connection reports error or sessionEnded; no automatic retries are requested (retries: 0, capacityRetryBudgetMs: 0).

outputs.name: connectDecart

The preview also stops once session.seconds * 1000 milliseconds have passed, when the document becomes hidden, when the prompt's signal aborts, or when the connection reports error or sessionEnded; no automatic retries are requested (retries: 0, capacityRetryBudgetMs: 0).

errors.name: Error
errors.description: connect rejects with Error when the prompt has no connector ('Live AI is unavailable until a credential-safe provider transport is configured.'), when the prompt's signal is already aborted ('AI preview cancelled.'), or when the connector throws or rejects ('AI video connection failed. The simple renderer remains available.'). Connector failures stop the captured tracks before the rejection, and an error from canvas.captureStream(25) is not caught, so it reaches the caller unchanged.
